Name: Tiny Totem Statue Obelisks
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
These seasonally colored tiny totem statues will replace the obelisks on your farms! 

[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]
[b][size=3]✧ Obelisk Retextures ✧ [/size][/b]
Replace your giant obelisks with tiny, convenient statues. With[b] solid 1x1 bases[/b], they allow the player character to move around them with ease. Every obelisk will be replaced with same small totem statue it teleports you to! Each statue has been recolored to align with the [b]seasonal appearances[/b] of the farm statue, ensuring a consistent and harmonious look throughout the year. Using [b]vanilla textures[/b] as a base, these statues blend seamlessly into your world, maintaining the game’s classic aesthetic. Each statue is designed to be small, discreet, and decorative, easily fitting into any nook or cranny of your farm without taking up valuable space.  Additionally, all statues feature small and consistent hand-drawn shadows, adding depth and realism.
These obelisks are now supported:
[list]
[*]Earth[/*]
[*]Water[/*]
[*]Desert[/*]
[*]Island[/*]
[*]Farm (Ginger Island only)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] (original art credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]lemurkat[/url], used with permission)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] (original art credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url], used with permission)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Downtown Zuzu[/url] (original art credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/111722573]XxHarvzBackxX[/url], used with permission)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url] (original art credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumisteria[/url], used with permission)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38548]Aurora Vineyard Travel Pack[/url] (original art by JennaJuffuffles)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31511]Friendable Mr. Qi[/url] (original art credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68147882]AngelOfStars[/url], used with permission)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12089]Dam[/url] (original art credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78813038]tikamin557[/url], used with permission)[/*]
[/list][i]If you would like to request another obelisk be added to the list, let me know! If you are an expansion creator interested in having your obelisk be supported here as well, please reach out![/i]

[b][size=3]✧ Return Home Obelisk ✧ [/size][/b]
Build the new Home Obelisk to travel back to your home farm from any of your remote farms!
The following maps are supported without additional configuration:
[list]
[*]All vanilla maps (Standard, Forest, Hilltop, Riverland, Wilderness, Four Corners, Beach, Meadowlands)[/*]
[*]Frontier Farm[/*]
[*]Grandpa's Farm[/*]
[*]Immersive Farm 2 Remastered[/*]
[*]Lnh MiNiFarm[/*]
[*]Personal Farm V1, V2, V3[/*]
[*]WaFF/WaFFLE[/*]
[*]Zenith Farm by DaisyNiko[/*]
[*]Custom X, Y coordinates are also supported![/*]
[/list][i]If you would like to request another map be added to the list, feel free to supply the coordinates for in front of the statue on that farm, along with a link to the mod, in the posts forum and I will add it in the next update![/i]

[b][size=3]✧ Mini-Obelisk ✧ [/size][/b]
Based on popular demand there is now a also mini-obelisk retexture included! Replace your mini-obelisk with either a signpost statue or the farm mouse statue!

[b][size=3]✧ Known Issues ✧ [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]You will need to Quit to Title if you wish to enable or disable rextures for modded obelisks.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Disable obelisk replacers in your recolor or buildings mod to work best with this mod. [/size][/*]
[*][size=2]If you experience any other problems with this mod, or have any suggestions how it can be improved upon, I am all ears![/size][/*]
[/list]﻿
